# VinylDeck
> Windows desktop app that renders the active system media session as a cinematic vinyl deck with realtime synced lyrics.

## Primary Docs
- `README.md`: public project overview, quick start, features, links
- `docs/USER_GUIDE.md`: user controls, realtime lyrics, settings, window modes
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: system design, lyrics pipeline, and state ownership
- `docs/API.md`: Tauri command/event contracts
- `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`: contributor setup and verification
- `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`: common runtime and lyrics issues
- `docs/RELEASE_V1.md`: version notes and distribution checklist
- `CHANGELOG.md`: notable changes

## Core Concepts
- Browser mode uses `MockSource` (with deterministic demo lyrics fixtures).
- Tauri mode uses `TauriSource` over Rust SMTC commands and events.
- React consumes `PlaybackState`; Rust owns Windows media integration.
- Rust owns persisted settings and emits backend-approved settings snapshots.
- Realtime lyrics resolve through a Rust-backed multi-tier cascade (`cmd_lyrics_fetch`: LyricsPlus -> BetterLyrics TTML -> LRCLIB) with zero-flicker 2-layer 60fps DOM-ref word sweep, 3-dot instrumental gap interludes, tucked background vocals, damped-spring scrolling, and automatic collapse on instrumental/no-lyrics tracks.
- Free zero-key Romanization replaces primary lyrics in-place (preserving karaoke word sweep) using native Apple Music TTML `<iTunesMetadata>` syllable-timed transliterations, instant offline romanizers (Korean Hangul, Japanese Kana, Punjabi Gurmukhi, Hindi Devanagari), and per-line bounded-concurrency Rust enrichment (`cmd_lyrics_enrich`), with opt-in Auto-Romanize (never auto-translates) and customizable font family, font size, and Split View side.
- Settings includes a dedicated `LYRICS` tab (`LOOK | VINYL | LYRICS | DISPLAY | OTHER | ABOUT`); the right-click context menu stays slim and essential-only.
- Start With Windows is a Rust-owned persisted setting backed by Tauri autostart.
- Mini Transparency is a Rust-owned persisted setting; it applies native Acrylic only to the Mini window.
- Active visual shells are Noir and Glass.
- CSS vinyl renderer is active.
- Album art drives ambient color and vinyl material styling.

## Important Paths
- `src/App.tsx`: app boot and render-mode routing
- `src/views/`: main and mini views (unified Pure/Split/Strip stage choreography)
- `src/components/`: visual and interaction components including `LyricsStage`, `Tooltip`, and `Settings`
- `src/hooks/`: playback, idle, keyboard shortcuts, `useLyrics`, and `useLyricsSync`
- `src/lib/lyrics/`: lyrics types, offline romanizer (`romanize.ts`), parsers (LyricsPlus, TTML, LRC, GTX, interludes), provider cascade, and demo fixtures
- `src/lib/playback/`: playback contracts, store, mock source, Tauri source
- `src/lib/settings/`: frontend settings adapter/cache
- `src-tauri/src/lyrics/`: Rust lyrics fetch and per-line romanization/translation enrichment commands
- `src-tauri/src/media/`: SMTC integration
- `src-tauri/src/settings/`: settings authority
- `src-tauri/src/window/`: window modes
- `src-tauri/src/tray.rs`: tray lifecycle

## Verification
```powershell
npm run build
npm run test:frontend
npm run fmt:rust
npm run clippy:rust
npm run test:rust
```

- **v2.3.0**: On-disk Rust LRU lyrics cache (`0ms` reload across restarts), subtle depth-of-field lyric focus blur, zero-shift karaoke wrapping for overlapping background vocals, high-contrast Glass & Noir Settings modal, and unified System Tray + Windows SMTC controls.
